title: Proposal to Measure Developments based on Biodiversity Improvement Score
what_it_is: Proposal to Measure Developments based on Biodiversity Improvement Score

sections.label: LUSH replacement greenery requirement
sections.summary: LUSH requires developers to provide replacement greenery, up to 40% of site area, and has supported over 440 hectares since 2009.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of National Development)
sentences.text: Under LUSH, developers must provide replacement greenery within new developments, which can be up to 40% of the development site area in some cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of National Development)
sentences.text: Since its inception in 2009, LUSH has supported the implementation of over 440 hectares of greenery, which is more than the size of 600 football fields.

sections.label: Singapore versus UK biodiversity approach
sections.summary: Singapore assesses its balanced, coordinated biodiversity approach as better for Singapore than the UK's Biodiversity Net Gain framework of imposing targets on individual projects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of National Development)
sentences.text: We are mindful not to adopt practices in other countries without first understanding their suitability for our local context.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister of National Development)
sentences.text: We assess that our balanced and coordinated approach to enhancing biodiversity can achieve better outcomes for Singapore, compared to the United Kingdom's (UK's) Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) framework approach of imposing biodiversity targets on individual development projects.

sections.label: UK mandatory biodiversity net gain
sections.summary: The UK's framework requires a mandatory 10% biodiversity net gain for new developments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: My second supplementary question, the UK's framework requires a mandatory 10% biodiversity net gain for new developments.

sections.label: LUSH part of biodiversity strategy
sections.summary: LUSH is one part of Singapore's strategy, which also includes safeguarding 7,800 hectares of green spaces, nature parks, habitat restoration and species recovery.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The LUSH project, now in its third iteration, is just a one part of our overall strategy to enhance and to preserve biodiversity in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I mentioned earlier on my Parliamentary Question reply that we have also safeguarded 7,800 hectares of green spaces and will establish additional nature parks, restore core habitats, conduct species recovery for rare, threatened and endemic species.

sections.label: HDB Yishun Chencharu environmental assessment
sections.summary: HDB worked with biodiversity experts and nature groups on the environmental impact assessment for Yishun Chencharu Build-To-Order flats to enhance nature planting and implement an environmental monitoring management plan.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In that project, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) has worked with biodiversity experts and the nature groups on the environmental impact assessment (EIA) for the Yishun Chencharu Build-To-Order flats to enhance nature planting, and also to build in advance and then implement an environmental monitoring management plan to design green spaces and linear parks.

sections.label: Singapore's holistic biodiversity approach
sections.summary: The Member's suggestion to look at external examples is not quite appropriate to Singapore's context, which has a larger, more holistic, more coordinated approach.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I appreciate the Member's suggestion in looking at external examples, but I think that is not quite appropriate to Singapore's context.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We have a larger, more holistic, more coordinated approach to enhancing biodiversity.
